main_transfer_selection: Reuse the minimum 0.7 target-distance + 0.3 change-distance point in the verified fixed path grid; also check the task2 conditional-median Stale grade does not increase. No new search if the recorded optimum passes.
chemical_policy: Supplied monotone coordinates must not increase; this is more conservative than threshold excess and assumes the same monotone coordinate map before and after. Reference-zero caps for missing Diacetyl are conditional nonnegative-concentration assumptions, not recovered measurements.
stale_policy: All three retained standardized Stale point proxies and the task2 relative-grade point estimate must not increase. Model agreement is not a calibrated bound or a measured outcome.
reference_decision: Keep measured-reference and 1% IQR results as supplementary scenarios. The held-out reference correction has no predictive advantage; do not use reference-anchored scores as the primary sensory fingerprint.
grade_semantics: Same task2 conditional-median relative grades for 50 labelled targets plus two explicitly marked reference-threshold scenarios; no raw card intensity recovery.
scope: Q3 main delivery only. Reuse existing generation comparison and Stale diagnostics; no new model family, tuning, brewing validation, paper or Q2 work.
